Adoption.title: Adoption
Adoption.description: Delivered EV adoption statistics; `not_loaded` until the file arrives.

AdoptionScenario.title: AdoptionScenario
AdoptionScenario.description: The latest adoption figure, shown for planning only. Not a model input.

AreaHour.title: AreaHour
AreaHour.description: One forecast hour across the cells in view: the hottest and wettest cell.

note.title: Note
note.description: Set when a live forecast sits beside simulated load data

AreaOutlook.title: AreaOutlook
AreaOutlook.description: The next OUTLOOK_HOURS of forecast for the transformers in view.

CellPeak.title: CellPeak
CellPeak.description: A weather cell's hottest forecast hour in the outlook window.

Charger.title: Charger
Charger.description: One public DOE charging station (a public site, not a home).

ChargerMap.title: ChargerMap
ChargerMap.description: DOE stations in view, and the radius used to link them to transformers.

ClampHealth.title: ClampHealth
ClampHealth.description: Retrofit clamp counts for one transformer (or an area). Counts only, never a device.

ClampMap.title: ClampMap
ClampMap.description: Every clamp in view, with status judged against `as_of` (the latest report of any clamp).

ClampPoint.title: ClampPoint
ClampPoint.description: One installed clamp, placed at its household's building. Carries no household identity.

CoverageMap.title: CoverageMap
CoverageMap.description: Per-transformer clamp coverage in view. Counts only: no clamp, home or household.

DashboardSummary.title: DashboardSummary
DashboardSummary.description: The summary row: as-of time, tiers, actions, weather freshness, clamps and model.

DeviceReading.title: DeviceReading
DeviceReading.description: HTTP device report. Legacy identifiers are accepted but assignment is server-owned.

LoadPoint.title: LoadPoint
LoadPoint.description: Transformer load at one 15-minute interval; `is_forecast` marks the predicted part.

ModelSummary.title: ModelSummary
ModelSummary.description: Strategies used; `kept` is the backtest verdict (null for baselines).

OutageDetail.title: OutageDetail
OutageDetail.description: Engineer view: the exact pin, the transformer, and the evidence behind the pin.

OutageSummary.title: OutageSummary
OutageSummary.description: Public outage card: area, cause and a restoration range.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Share of homes reporting (clamp health); coverage when unknown

RiskOutput.title: RiskOutput
RiskOutput.description: Risk for one transformer over the forecast window.

heat_index_max_c.title: Heat Index Max C
heat_index_max_c.description: Highest forecast heat index in the next 24 h, °C

ev_stations_within.title: Ev Stations Within
ev_stations_within.description: Public DOE chargers within the EV radius

ev_evening_step_kw.title: Ev Evening Step Kw
ev_evening_step_kw.description: Evening load step: last 7 days minus days 8 to 28, kW

weather_note.title: Weather Note
weather_note.description: Set when a live forecast sits beside simulated load data

TransformerCard.title: TransformerCard
TransformerCard.description:
The transformer card: risk plus the last 48 h and the next 24 h of load, why it is
flagged, the weather ahead, EV exposure and how many more clamps would reach the target.

TransformerCoverage.title: TransformerCoverage
TransformerCoverage.description: Clamp counts for one transformer and the clamps still needed for the target.

TransformerEv.title: TransformerEv
TransformerEv.description: EV exposure of one transformer: DOE stations within the radius.

heat_index_max_c.title: Heat Index Max C
heat_index_max_c.description: Highest forecast heat index in the next 24 h, °C

ev_stations_within.title: Ev Stations Within
ev_stations_within.description: Public DOE chargers within the EV radius

ev_evening_step_kw.title: Ev Evening Step Kw
ev_evening_step_kw.description: Evening load step: last 7 days minus days 8 to 28, kW

TransformerRisk.title: TransformerRisk
TransformerRisk.description:
One pin on the engineer risk map, and one row of the action queue.

Dashboard fields are null on runs scored before they existed.

WeatherHour.title: WeatherHour
WeatherHour.description: One forecast hour in one weather cell.

WeatherSummary.title: WeatherSummary
WeatherSummary.description: The forecast behind the view and its hottest hour ahead.

silip__shared__scores__domain__Driver.title: Driver
silip__shared__scores__domain__Driver.description:
One reason behind a score, as a feature and its value. `contribution` is the model's
per-feature contribution (LightGBM `pred_contrib`); null when the rules scorer gave it.

silip_ml__risk__domain__Driver.title: Driver
silip_ml__risk__domain__Driver.description: One model input that pushed the score up, with its contribution (log-odds) and sentence.
